Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jbig2dec/annex-h.jbig2').read_bytes()
# create a few randomized candidates by truncating after header and appending zeros
for n in [64,80,96,112,128,160,192,256,320,400,500,600,700,800]:
    Path(f'/tmp/t{n}.jbig2').write_bytes(src[:n])
print('made')
PY
for f in /tmp/t*.jbig2; do echo --- $f ---; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/jbig2dec/.libs /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/jbig2dec/.libs/jbig2dec "$f" >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e; echo exit:$?; tail -1 /tmp/e; done | head -100
